from (bucket: "my-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "utilities")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "electricity_generation")
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "daily_electricity_generation")
  |> derivative(unit: 1d, columns: ["daily_electricity_generation"], timeColumn: "_time")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "daily_electricity_generation"])
